scope: tracking only; no interception; no unrequested tail metrics

shared_contract.W3_timing_note: unoptimized Python with complex-step Jacobians; no cost ordering is claimed

candidate_design.input_penalty_semantics: R is applied once per prediction stage in WrenchMPC; it is not multiplied by the number of move blocks

tuning.finalists_per_arm: three best non-current candidates plus current

selection.W2_forward_rule: If W2a and W2b selected configurations have equal reliability counts, the lower selected full-validation tracking score goes forward. Otherwise the same preregistered lexicographic reliability ordering applies. Both remain in the blind test.

reported_metrics: position velocity yaw RMSE mean median P95 max on completed
solve time mean P95 max count over 10ms with throughput probe

paired_comparisons.metric: per-scenario position RMSE among mutually completed pairs
paired_comparisons.win_test: two-sided exact sign test, ties excluded

failure_policy: retain and label every failed run
